**Finding: Compliant (preferred position).**

No exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binds Corio:
- **Grant of rights (§§ 2.1–2.4, 12.3):** all licences to Corio are expressly *nonexclusive*; § 2.7 restricts only copying/reverse engineering, not sourcing.
- **Exhibit D (Sales & Marketing Cooperation):** expressly "non-binding," so no de facto exclusive-promotion commitment.
- **§ 14.8:** confirms Corio solely directs the Corio Services and may subcontract to third parties.
- **Definitions (Corio Market Segment / Customer):** scope the licence, not our purchasing freedom.
- The only exclusivity-flavoured terms run **in our favour** (§ 2.4 — Commerce One must refer Corio Customers back to Corio), which we leave untouched.

No redline proposed.
